feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 April 2026 10:06pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 30 April 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure continuing to decline near Denmark with shallow low in the Atlantic slowly approaching southern Ireland.


##Wind##

Southeast 4 or 5, veering south 2 to occasionally 4 tomorrow morning then increasing south or south-southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, but still 3 or less in the east of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers will spread from the southwest overnight. Areas or mist and isolated fog patches then developing from the south during tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers. Becoming moderate or poor later, but very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, but 3 or less in the southeast of the area at first, Becoming south or southeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers with the risk of mist and isolated fog patches at first.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, but very poor in fog patches.
